# GetTCPStreamAddress

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetTCPStreamAddress:String tcp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address on the other end of a TCP stream, as text: `127.0.0.1` for IPv4 and `::1` for IPv6. Use it instead of [TCPStreamIP](TCPStreamIP) when the peer may use IPv6, as that returns 0 for these.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Not in the original, which only knows IPv4. See [IPv6](IPv6).
